MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  Special City Council Meeting
  April 12, 2024

A Special Meeting of the City Council, the Community Development Financing Authority, the
Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency, the Housing Authority, and the
Library Board of Trustees of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor
Kelley at 3:02 p.m., on April 12, 2024, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 4:00 p.m. on April 10, 2024, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. Copies were also posted
at Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive, and Norman P. Murray
Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

*All Board and Agency memberships are reflected in the title "Council Member."

Present:  Council Member Bucknum
  Council Member Goodell (arrived at 3:04 pm)
  Council Member Vasquez
  Mayor Pro Tem Ruesch
  Mayor Kelley

Absent:  None

Staff Present: William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Kimberly Schmitt, City Clerk

 CLOSED SESSION

Larry Gilbert, M.V.: Questioned the adjournment at the April 9 meeting to April 23, but that 24
hours later a meeting was called at 3:00 pm. He asked why this was not at normal meeting hours.
Voiced concerns with three Council Members termed out in 2026 will bring added debt to the
new Council. He also questioned why the City didn’t conduct a national search for the City
Manager position.

Cathy Schlicht, M.V.: Criticized the City Manager that he was well aware of these Special
Meetings last Tuesday. Criticized the Council is afraid to go outside because a new City Manager
might bring transparency that will not happen here. She stated that the city has a corrupted
government.

City Attorney Curley explained that the Closed Session is for consideration for public employment
of the City Manager Position. This is a properly noticed Special Meeting which requires 24 notice
that was followed.

 CS1.  Public Employment/Appointment Position: City Manager

City Council Special Meeting Minutes  1  April 23, 2024
  RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION AND RECONVENE

 At the hour of 3:09 pm Mayor Kelley recessed the meeting to Closed Session. The City Council
 reconvened at 4:59 pm with all five Council Members present.

 REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

 Mayor Kelley announced that City Manager Wilberg and City Attorney Curley may commence
 negotiation of an employment contract. The City Council unanimously selection Elaine Lister for
 City Manager.

 At the hour of 5:00 p.m., Mayor Kelley adjourned the meeting.

______________________________________________
Kimberly Schmitt, City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of April 23, 2024
